Re-cut: all 12 figures (main from the native 300 dpi rasters; SI re-rendered at 300 dpi from the raster placement rectangles — the auto crops had wide uneven margins, Fig. 2 had swallowed the running foot, Fig. S1 had taken the heading 'List of Supporting Figures') and Tables 1–3 (Table 2 lost its footnote and bottom rule, Table 3 its bottom rule); Tables S1–S5 kept. Added by hand: the TOC graphic (no caption), 17 panel crops (1a–c · 1d · 1e · three SEM insets · 2a–f · 3a–c · 3d · 3e · S7a · S7b) and 17 evidence paragraphs (main 11 · SI 6, incl. the 1.64 sentence). The paper has no equations (numbered or inline) — the definitions of relative density, σ = L/(R·A) and the DC electronic conductivity are sentences only and were cut as evidence paragraphs. After the first visual check 5 crops were re-cut (1d/1e and S7a/S7b: axis titles had landed on the neighbouring panel; S7b again to drop a picture-border line) and the text-crop search window was narrowed (the p.266 crop had taken Fig. 1e and its caption) (2026-11-12, litdb-curator).
note_manual: Printed inconsistencies visible in the crops: a(Li6PS5Cl) 9.8590(3) Å in Fig. 1d (and Fig. 3d read 9.8589) vs 9.8598(3) Å in Table S1; a(Li6PS5Br) 9.9840(4) Å in Fig. 1e (Fig. 3d read 9.9840) vs 9.9855(4) Å in Table S2 (same R_Bragg / χ²); a(Cl0.75Br0.25) 9.8880(5) Å in Figure S3 vs 9.8880(4) Å in Table S3; Figure S6 caption labels both (a) and (c) Li6PS5Cl0.75Br0.25; Fig. 3d axis 'Lattice parameter' has no unit; abstract 'impurity contents ranging from 3 to 10%' = the range of single impurity phases (Tables 1–2: 3.3–10 %), while the argyrodite is 77(5) % of Li6PS5Cl (impurities ≈21–23 %); text '∼2.4 mS·cm−1 … for the Cl and Br phases' vs 1.9 for Br; '6 orders of magnitude' vs 5.4–5.9 decades (Table 3); 'two tons' without unit system (metric tonne → ≈250 MPa on ⌀10 mm); 'external standard' for Si that is mixed into the sample (standard addition); SI typos 'vale', 'died', 'argyodite', 'argryodites'. Number checks (card §3-6): Cl pellet (100 mg, ⌀10 mm, 34 Ω, 2.4 mS/cm) gives 0.641 mm and 1.99 g/cm³ — not 99 % of 1.64; Br closes (0.686 mm, 97.6 % of 1.90); DC σ_e from Fig. 2f + that thickness = 7.0–7.2 × 10−6 vs printed 4.4 × 10−6 mS/cm.
